given: A named remote environment and explicit profile file select an existing runner.
when: Create the plan and obtain preflight output.
impact: Preflight reports an incomplete invocation. Reusing its command without inherited environment variables makes the remote runner reject the missing target.
next_action: Retain invocation_environment in the preflight plan projection, including null removals.
limits: Runner rejection follows the explicit e2e/remote.config.ts target guard. No application suite was started.
